message.content: {"language":"en","text":"This RSI strategy produced a positive result over the test window, but it lagged simply holding SPY. The ride included a sharp early drop, a recovery, and a second drawdown before the portfolio finished at a new high. Holding through the run meant accepting a maximum decline of about 4.8%, illustrated as roughly $48 on the starting $1,000, in exchange for a smoother path than the benchmark may suggest, but the tradeoff was giving up 8.29 percentage points versus SPY.\n\nA useful next historical question is whether changing the RSI entry or exit thresholds would alter that benchmark gap, without treating the result as a forecast.","figures":[{"fact_key":"portfolio.total_return","value":8.6},{"fact_key":"portfolio.benchmark_gap","value":-8.29},{"fact_key":"portfolio.max_drawdown","value":4.82},{"fact_key":"portfolio.drawdown_illustration","value":48.2}]}
